messages.subject: Cannot download plot from shiny-server
parts:
Hi everyone,
I have the following problem regarding a shiny-app that i developed.

I created a shiny-server on ubuntu 12.04 that is reachable and working. Default apps work fine and also "my app" is working great!
The problem arises when i try to download the plot that the app created using the server.

When i launch the app in "local", i can download the plot with no issue (i can decide the type of the image - PNG PDF JPEG) and everything works fine.
When i connect to the server, same app "my app" is working but plot are downloaded as EMPTY and cant be opened (they are not blank, they can't be even opened).

Do you know what kind of issue i am facing?

I mean, i don't think that the problem is on the server.R or ui.R because the app is working.

Thank you
Davide
